subject: How to estimate random intercepts of a variable with 9 levels in lavaan

messages.author: 419554265a2e83be
messages.subject: How to estimate random intercepts of a variable with 9 levels in lavaan
parts:
I want to model a 9-level variable as a random effect as opposed to fixed. I know that with lavaan, one can estimate the random effects of a two-level variable (Multilevel SEM). Could anyone have an idea or suggestions on how I can model a 9-level variable as a random effect in lavaan?

I am working with data from 9 different regions that have inherent heterogeneity, thus the need to treat this variable as a random effect and not a fixed effect in SEM.

In mixed linear models, one could model a random effect, as shown in the model below. 

mixed_model <- lmer(outcome_variable ~ Variable1 + Variable1 + (1 | 9_level_variable)  , data = my_data)

Any insights are greatly appreciated.
